dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: How I miss this sight... Here, your presents are ready too. Please, take them.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: They're all seeds of plants that won't grow here. If you have a yard somewhere else, you can watch them mature there.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Ah, I just rambled for a long time... But it feels good.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Before you got here, I really didn't have many friends, and it could get pretty lonely.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: Very few people in the village are into gardening.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: ...Well, that's not entirely true. An old man living to the north of the village also plowed a plot to grow flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: I've visited him before. He's a slightly eccentric old man.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: I saw him planting stones, but he insisted that they were flowers, and even kicked me out.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: It must be lonely, living all by himself. I can understand that.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: You helped me with my Sumeru Roses... Maybe you can help him with his plants too.

dialogues.speaker: Sabbah
dialogues.text: You and Paimon should visit him if you get a chance.
